_fixture: A GuardDuty finding in its REAL delivery shape: an EventBridge event, not a
CloudTrail record. There is no Records[] array, so
Projector.ProjectCloudTrail decodes it successfully and returns ZERO
observations with no error -- the worst available failure mode, because a
silent zero is indistinguishable from a quiet account.
This file exists to pin that, not to be ingested:
names the follow-up. It is deliberately NOT in KusariFixtureFiles(), so it
never reaches a policy rule and never contributes a finding to the e2e
The follow-up: GuardDuty findings need either an EventBridge-shaped
projection path with its own §2.3 label rows, or a forwarder that re-shapes
them onto the CloudTrail envelope before they reach the bucket. Both are
projection work in a package this card does not extend.

detail.title: API GetBucketPolicy was invoked from a known malicious IP address.
